fact: Loi n° 2024-002 relative aux Startup technologiques et innovantes sets up a startup label with a labelling committee, customs and tax exemptions for labelled startups, and a Fonds d'Innovation et d'Appui aux Startup (FIAS) financed by the state budget, to be regulated by decree.
title: Loi relative aux Startup Technologiques et Innovantes (Loi n° 2024-002)
